messages:
mira: dropped a compact variant for the trace header actions — open to feedback on which CTAs are primary on narrow widths. figma: https://redwood.test/figma/trace-compact
raul: nice. i'd make Download/Export a top-level action during incidents. support needs it fast.
jess: a11y quick flags: toolbar needs role="toolbar" + aria-label, icon buttons must have aria-labels, and hit targets 44px. current mock has 36px.
kai: tech note: export runs async and returns a signed link. we can add a transient chip "Download ready" in the header that lasts 24h.
mira: proposed primary order for compact: [Copy correlation ID] [Open] [Download]. kebab keeps annotate/pin/share. on really small screens collapse to two icons and move Download to the right metadata area.
raul: agree. also use explicit labels: "Copy correlation ID" and "Open trace in new tab". short labels reduce confusion for non-engineers.
jess: keyboard shortcuts: C=copy, O=open, D=download. ensure they are documented in the keyboard help overlay and that shortcuts don't conflict with embedded editors.
kai: for copying truncated ids: UI can truncate but Copy must copy full id. add a small toast: "Full correlation ID copied" announced via aria-live.
uxbot: automated scan: contrast on icon hover state 2.7:1 (fails). recommend either increase contrast or add a visible focus ring with 4.5:1.
mira: will update mock to 44px targets and add visible focus style. small UX: primary click for Download should kick off quick-export (no modal). advanced options live in kebab -> "Download (advanced)" which opens an accessible modal with presets.
raul: filename pattern suggestion: trace-<id>-<env>-<YYYYMMDDHHMM>.zip and include manifest.json describing fields included.
jess: modal must trap focus and have descriptive labels for checkboxes. when export starts announce "Trace download started" and on completion announce "Trace download ready: link in notifications."
kai: implementer note: we'll add aria-live messages and persistent chip; CSV flattening will be opt-in in advanced modal. estimate 1 sprint.
mira: action items: 1) update figma with compact + 44px + focus (mira). 2) eng to add aria-live + persistent chip + copy behavior (kai). 3) a11y to re-scan after updates (jess). will post new frames by EOD. :thumbsup:
